title: Musicians of the Ninth Ward and downriver
summary: Big Eye Louis and the Ninth Ward musicians (Duran, Joseph Watson, Charlie Bernard, Joe Hoodoo) and talk of players who went down to Delacroix Island.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
